method: Built-in Codex image_gen image-to-image editing of actual NotebookLM PDF pages

edits.style_reference_role: Style only; source text, diagram, labels and arrow relationships are authoritative
edits.prompt:
Edit target: the FIRST reference image is the actual NotebookLM slide. Preserve its complete educational content, labels, layer relationships and explanatory structure. The SECOND reference is STYLE ONLY: use its dense Ink Theater engraved black linework, warm ivory paper, cobalt blue and vermilion accents, confident serif lettering and restrained ornamental border. Do not copy its landscape layout. Create an independently composed native PORTRAIT 9:16 slide, ideally 1080x1920, for a YouTube Short. Do not crop, pad, blur, letterbox or shrink the landscape slide into a portrait canvas.

Keep every following English text exactly once, verbatim (line breaks may change):
Three Layers of Order Execution
Navigating triggers, price constraints, and execution realities in market microstructure.
1. The Trigger
2. The Execution Price
3. The Completed Fill
An order trigger, an execution price, and a completed fill are three fundamentally different mechanical events.

Retain the source diagram: exactly three hollow square layers in perspective stacked vertically. Top layer vermilion, middle layer cobalt, bottom layer ivory with black engraving. Each layer has its own unambiguous arrow to the correct numbered label: 1 top, 2 middle, 3 bottom. Keep the diagram large and readable. Reflow the original title at the top, subtitle beneath it, diagram and labels in the middle, and the complete original explanatory sentence beneath them. Never convert this slide into a poster or replace its diagram with a new metaphor.

For the 1080x1920 coordinate model, place ALL essential title, subtitle, diagram, arrows, numbered labels and explanatory text inside x=80..850 and y=180..1430. Reserve x=900..1080 and y=1500..1920 as quiet ivory paper, with only subtle texture; no words, icons, labels, footer or semantic content there. The rest of the canvas remains native portrait paper, not inserted bands. Readable typography and dense useful content within the safe zone. No clouds, scenery, people, mascots, new objects, formulas, extra words, invented claims, QR codes, logos, watermark or NotebookLM mark. Output just the final slide image.
edits.reason: Content retained, but title begins above y=180, long labels overlap the right control zone, and bottom explanation extends below y=1430 in normalized 1080x1920 coordinates. Targeted native layout correction required.
